Urban Front Open Cabin Hard Luggage Trolley Bag – Premium Polycarbonate Travel Gear

Upgrade your travel experience with the Urban Front Open Cabin Hard Luggage Trolley Bag, designed for modern travellers who demand convenience, durability, and security. This cabin-friendly trolley bag is engineered using high-grade Polycarbonate material, making it strong, lightweight, and impact-resistant. Whether you’re travelling for business or leisure, this hard luggage trolley ensures smooth mobility and organised packing every time.

Equipped with advanced travel-friendly features like a Keyless TSA Lock, Anti-Theft Zipper, 360 Degree Spinner Wheels, and a built-in USB Charging Port, this Urban Cabin Luggage is ideal for frequent flyers. The convenient Front Open design allows instant access to essentials like laptops, documents, chargers, and travel accessories without opening the main compartment. Its ergonomic build and Ultra Stable Trolley system ensure effortless handling across airports, hotels, and transit routes.

Why Choose the Urban Front Open Cabin Hard Luggage Trolley Bag?

This premium cabin-size trolley bag meets international travel standards and offers unmatched durability for long-term use. Designed to simplify your journey, it features smart compartments that make Packing Made Easy. With superior scratch resistance, shock absorption, and an intelligent power charging system, this bag is a perfect fit for business travellers, weekend explorers, and frequent flyers.

Top Features

  • Material: Polycarbonate – Lightweight, robust, and impact-resistant for long-lasting performance.
  • Front Open Cabin Design – Quick access to laptop, chargers, travel documents, and essentials.
  • Keyless TSA Lock – Enhances travel security and allows hassle-free international check-ins.
  • Ultra Stable Trolley – Strong telescopic handle with smooth height adjustment.
  • USB Charging Port – Charge your mobile devices on the go with a dedicated power-bank compartment.
  • 360 Degree Spinner Wheel – Multi-directional wheels for effortless gliding on any surface.
  • Anti-Theft Zipper – Double-layer security to protect valuables during travel.
  • Packing Made Easy – Smart compartments and elastic cross straps for organised packing.
  • Warranty: 5 Years Replacement – Coverage against any manufacturing defect for complete peace of mind.

Enhanced Travel Convenience & Security

Every feature of this is designed to make travelling smarter and stress-free. The Keyless TSA Lock ensures your belongings stay protected while complying with global travel standards. The Anti-Theft Zipper adds another layer of safety, making it ideal for airport travel, long routes, and busy transit areas.

Its Front Open design provides unmatched convenience by allowing you to quickly access gadgets and essential items without unlocking the main compartment. For travellers who value speed and organisation, this function is a major advantage.

Smooth Mobility with 360° Spinner Wheels

The trolley features 360 Degree Spinner Wheels to glide smoothly across airport terminals and hotel lobbies. Combined with the Ultra Stable Trolley handle, your luggage moves effortlessly, reducing wrist strain and improving travel comfort.

Stay Powered with USB Charging Port

Never run out of battery while travelling. The built-in USB Charging Port allows you to connect your power bank and charge your phone, tablet, or headphones on the go. This feature makes it ideal for business travellers and airport layovers.

Durable, Stylish & Cabin-Friendly

Made with premium-grade Polycarbonate material, this cabin-size hard trolley bag resists scratches, dents, and harsh handling. Its stylish, modern design and compact structure meet airline cabin baggage size guidelines for smooth and worry-free boarding.

Perfect for Every Traveler

Whether you’re a frequent flyer, corporate traveler, student, or holiday explorer, the is built to meet all your travel needs. Its smart organisation, security features, and powerful build quality make it the perfect travel companion.
